scope: Summary of 35 project stage folders; 24 had primary presentation renders. Full history remains in the private production archive. No private repository links or raw capture artifacts are required to review this showcase.

stages.title: Brief and evidence inventory
stages.decision: Define seven business goals, audit current footage and separate capability claims from captured proof.

stages.title: Existing portal references
stages.decision: Identify fictional/fixture-based local demonstrations as layout material, not live integration proof.

stages.title: Live capture and take selection
stages.decision: Record 17 takes and separate 12 editing candidates from five diagnostics/duplicates; retain native resolution and draft-state limits.

stages.title: Early audio staging
stages.decision: Prepare an audio working area; presence of a folder does not establish a finished mix.

stages.title: Capture-led storyboard revision
stages.decision: Repair flow and continuity before editing; preserve distinctions between different demonstration jobs.

stages.title: Edit workspace
stages.decision: Reserve editing structure; not a separately rendered version.

stages.title: Problem-first intro animatic
stages.decision: Explore fragmented systems, logins and fit before building the product reveal.

stages.title: Export workspace
stages.decision: Reserve output structure; not a separately rendered version.

stages.title: Light-theme motion concept
stages.decision: Establish navy, orange and light backgrounds with clean typography.

stages.title: Brand consistency and surface polish
stages.decision: Standardize PowerPortals naming and reduce visual roughness.

stages.title: Progressive opening and retiming
stages.decision: Give the first points time to appear; reclaim time from slower later feature introductions.

stages.title: First television-style pass
stages.decision: Move toward commercial rhythm, but retain layouts later rejected as too boxed.

stages.title: Unboxed commercial composition
stages.decision: Put free-standing words and a single orange motion accent front and center.

stages.title: Motion and positioning pass
stages.decision: Smooth the dot, improve text placement and preserve centered platform pairing.

stages.title: Sound and restrained depth
stages.decision: Time fewer effects to visual events; add subtle reveal depth and a logo-focused finish.

stages.title: Messaging efficiency review
stages.decision: Identify a 19-second problem setup in a 40-second cut and propose earlier product definition and proof.

stages.title: CEO audience critique
stages.decision: Frame value for a buyer who may not know why connected portals matter.

stages.title: CEO-oriented cut
stages.decision: Show a qualified invitation and clear audience relevance instead of relying on generic verbs alone.

stages.title: Interaction capture specification
stages.decision: Specify blank-to-value typing, real intermediate keystrokes, deliberate scrolling and readable result holds.

stages.title: Recorded interaction cut
stages.decision: Add live capture proof; the short duration still crowds reading and movement.

stages.title: Longer capture-led cut
stages.decision: Increase runtime for calmer demonstrations and keep captions short.

stages.title: Visual workflow and full BOM
stages.decision: Replace text-only automation explanation with a growing trigger/action graph; simplify material tracking into a coherent calculation.

stages.title: Ownership and completion
stages.decision: Assign illustrated people to tasks, show responsibility and carry progress to 100 percent.

stages.title: County and organization structure
stages.decision: Expand county records into a connected role/deal/customer map; Harris County is later replaced for the Florida audience.

stages.title: Florida relevance and role intro
stages.decision: Feature Hillsborough and its contact fields; preserve One while Project flips into Portal for Each Role.

stages.title: Dot endpoint continuity
stages.decision: Make an expanding circle return to the following scene's dot; later simplify the remaining detour into a direct slash.

stages.title: Completion, cost and service handoffs
stages.decision: Fill the check, gather the orange price, fold county fields together and demonstrate opening/replying from the team workspace.

stages.title: Text baseline and raster quality
stages.decision: Use shared alphabetic baselines, consistent column edges and one glyph source while text scales.

stages.title: Faster ramps and connected transitions
stages.decision: Reduce 108 seconds to 103.25, gather county text into its icon and round the workflow triangle into the reply-composer dot.

stages.title: Direct circle-to-slash reveal
stages.decision: Remove the tiny-dot detour and residual perspective drift; settle the slash at about 13 seconds.

stages.title: Generalize the structure label
stages.decision: Keep Hillsborough in the example but use County in the broader organization map.

stages.title: Benefit-led V2 plan
stages.decision: Translate feature names into problems and payoffs, plan industry flips and readable disclosure sequencing.

stages.title: Benefit-led V2 and industry ending
stages.decision: Preserve the established style while adding trade adaptability, a new score and an extended disclosure ending.

stages.title: Owner-supplied soundtrack
stages.decision: Use the supplied WAV as the sole music bed, separate individual effects and preserve the full song.

stages.title: Short branded close
stages.decision: Move disclosure to a five-second small footer, remove the large CTA and shorten the same track by ten bars.
